biography.plain_text: Robert Stigwood was an Australian entertainment entrepreneur based in Britain who built a business spanning artist management, records, theatre and film. His clients included the Bee Gees and Cream, while his productions included Grease and Evita. Through RSO, he combined commercially successful recordings with screen and stage rights that generated lasting royalties.

long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Stigwood recognised how one performance could sell another. Early in his work as a manager, he arranged for singer and actor John Leyton to perform Johnny Remember Me on television. The exposure helped turn the recording into a chart-topping hit, bringing Stigwood wider recognition in the music business.

For Saturday Night Fever, he acquired the magazine story's film rights and assembled the production before asking the Bee Gees for songs. He took the script to the group in France so they could write for the film's setting. Years later, he personally financed most of the London stage adaptation and regularly attended rehearsals, extending the story's commercial life beyond the cinema.

Forbes was searched first without an exact personal profile. Searches covered LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website, Facebook, Twitter/X, Youtube, TikTok, Vimeo and Flickr; results were tributes, unrelated people or organisations. TikTok indexing was restricted. No verified personal account found.

RSO's historical company site rsoprod.com was linked by its company LinkedIn page and archival references but failed direct access; no current site proposed. Trip Advisor and Zillow lack person-relevant professional context.

Music industry, Record label owner and Recorded-music rights would duplicate the more specific historically practiced roles selected. No musician or director role inferred from production credits. Three tags describe separate defining activities.

No health, sexuality or royalty-dispute detail is included in either biography. Government fellowship named after him is not attributed to his personal founding or funding.
